bestBets.overview: BOY CRUSH resumed from a spell with a strong first-up win, running down a filly in form. He should derive plenty of improvement from that effort and will appreciate the rise to 1200m. SWIFT RULER is a smart type who attacks this fresh without a trial. He made a big impression in his first preparation, winning two of his three starts in smart fashion. William Pike rides and I'm expecting him to be very strong late. SPINARELLA is racing well and should get every chance from her inside draw. GREY OL' DAY has trialled well.

raceTips.comment:
Geez wasn't BOY CRUSH impressive last start to run down Dawn Dancer over the 1000m when he was first up. 58.18 if you dont mind. 14 days later he steps up to the 1200m and I think he will be awfully hard to beat again.
YAMANEX has had her bit of bad luck at her early stage of the career. 3rd in the 2yo Magic Millions and amazed she got anywhere near them in the Gimcrack. Returns here with a handy trial win. Can nearly box seat this and the 1200m is an excellent start to her campaign.
SWIFT RULER clearly has ability. Just not sold on; 1. 91 days since we last saw him. 2. 1200m may be a touch short. 3. The map. I know he has drawn B4 of 7 but with Boy Crush and likely Snippets Return coming over I see a scenario where he may be the last pair in this 7 horse field. 
SPINARELLA next best who should get a soft run on the rail. Cracking race.

She can find the front and give a big kick again. MEMORY PARADE will appreciate the drop in class. She will get a soft run from her inside draw and should be strong late. ALL GRUNT can be hard to catch but has claims.

raceTips.comment:
MEMORY PARADE finds a race where she can finally break through this campaign. Needs another positive ride that she received from Natika last start but if she can hold leaders back she comes from clearly the best form lines in this race.
OLAF THE SNOWMAN is continuing his march through the grades. He was a maiden three starts ago. His last 4 races he has recorded the fastest L200,400 and 600m sectionals of his race. Gangemi's have him humming and beat home CHANTEL last start. Meets her better at the weights for it.

CHANTEL in a 66+ at Belmont in single figures. Never thought I would see the day. Take a bow JK.

He was a first-up 1400m winner last preparation and I'm expecting him to get every chance in running with Pike riding. SUPERNATURAL is rock-hard fit and continues to race well. She looked a big chance last start before peaking at the end of 1600m so the drop back to 1400m should be in her favour. EXCELTRAIN rolls forward and gives a sight. YOUGIVEMECHILLS has ability and can run a race fresh.

raceTips.comment:
We have a nice 72+ race here with a few different formlines. ARCADIA KNIGHT trialled up very well under the apprentice, beating home stablemate and Coolgardie Cup winner in Opportunistic. Pike is on, maps to sit box seat and while 1400m will be on the bottom of the range, he fires fresh.
SUPERNATURAL has only been beaten by Yes I know, The Crimson Pirate and Lillian at her last two starts. She is racing in phenomenal form and Chanel should be able to find our favourites back in running. Clear back and save on these top two.
EXCELTRAIN hasnt done a thing wrong either and maps to sit over the top of the speed with YOUGIVEMECHILLS and Chloe likely sitting last of the 8 horse field but he has trialled very nicely for his return.

bestBets.overview: COSMIC WALTZ has been a model of consistency all preparation without being able to crack it for a win. If he gets any luck from his sticky draw he goes very close again. STREAK OF GOD is on a seven-day back-up after a solid run over 1600m last Saturday. Pike sticks and I suspect the drop back to 1400m will prove a plus. MARDUSA was sound last week. He improves sharply off that and will appreciate the drop in grade/rise in trip. MAIN ACT parked on the speed and found plenty last start, producing a tough win. He can win again.

raceTips.comment:
COSMIC WALTZ has been knocking on the door and this is the chance to storm through it. Special conditions 55+ and has only been beaten by progressive Cinque Stelle and Silent Diva at his last two starts. There's a bit of front end pace in this though so Shooter will need to find the most economical passage. This is his race.
STREAK OF GOLD won well two starts back in the wet and last start was only beaten 2 lengths to Yes I Know when afforded every mortal. Will be giving our favourite a head start.
MAIN ACT had put the writing on the wall and deservedly got the win last start when going forward on a day you needed to. Tactically versatile so can run on from the back of the field today if they elect to ride him cold.
SNIP OF GOSSIP won first up last start (albeit in much easier) and the first part of his campaign was up to this - admittedly it did taper of. Trialled behind OLLY'S CHOICE who goes around single figures in a 72+ and he comes into a 55+ on close to the minimum with a good map. Absolute crazy roughie of the day.

bestBets.overview: BOSUN is a lightly raced and talented type who's starting to put it all together. He was a big last-start winner, coming very wide in the straight but still able to mow them down. If he gets any luck from his wide draw I expect him to make it a hat-trick. I LOVE YA MONEY is another talented type on the rise. Pike rides from a middle draw. JAZALOT is rock-hard fit and racing well. GET OUT MICK next best.

raceTips.comment:
BOSUN is the x-factor galloper in this race. He's big and raw and still putitng it together. B14 of 14 may seem terrible on paper, but the more I think about this race shape he is the type of horse I want with as much room as possible down the middle part of the track. He'll be motoring home.
I LOVE YA MONEY has been excellently placed by the Pateman stable and is progressing nicely, not utterly sold sold on him yet. 
GET OUT MICK is the roughie in the race - versatile and has only been beaten by some nice types.
SWIFT TALKER is a nice horse but maps terribly for his return to racing and doubt that he can outsprint our on-top selection.

bestBets.overview: MISS VEUVE got the job done last Saturday with William Pike steering. This looks a weaker race overall and I'm expecting her to go close despite the 60kg impost. SISTER MARY is hard fit and in career-best form. She'll get a soft run from her inside draw and perform well. PHAT CHAPS is a lightly raced type on the rise. This is his first attempt at the trip but I suspect he beats most of these on talent alone. ABISSI has claims despite the sharp rise in trip.

raceTips.comment:
Going to stick the neck out here and make ARGYLE STAR the best roughie all day. She will stay all day with a distinct lack of change up speed. She was in all sorts last start when 3 back the fence, shuffled back to near last on straightening and was only beaten 4lengths on finishing to SISTER MARY when Pike only rode hands and heels for the entirety. Expecting Stevie P to utilise the gate and go forward here. Her second start over the staying trip see's her take fitness benefit from last start and could be the one that gets under the market's nose.
SISTER MARY was good last start and she has been in some form for quite some time - this is her toughest test to date.
MISS VEUVE was a deserved winer last start in a 66+ but copped a stack of points and now is asked to carry 60kg and cant see her being 3 back the fence again.
WHISKERS HARBOUR two seconds and knocking on the door. Tricky staying maiden.

bestBets.overview: RISSOLES found the line fresh over the unsuitable 1000m. She improves off that run, has a good second-up card, will appreciate the rise in trip and gets Pike to ride. SNOWDOME is race fit and racing well. It's been a while since he last saluted (February 2025) but this does look a lovely assignment for him and he is particularly suited under the weight scale of the race. HAIDA GWAII was a strong winner first up. She has an impeccable winning strike rate and just needs luck from a sticky draw to go close again. GINNIVAN rolls forward and can give some cheek.

raceTips.comment:
RISSOLES was ultra impressive first up over the unsuitable 1000m without a trial. Closed home in the some of the fastest sectionals of the day to highlight her return. This race shape looks too good for her. Pace on with GINNIVAN, HAIDI GWAI, KELVINATOR, SNOWDOME and even SKY DUKE and FAST FLICKER holding positions - this sets up for a classic William Pike swooping run. Very keen.
FAST FLICKER is versatile enough to sit just of a hot tempo from B5 and was enormous first up last campaign when going around $80-1 and getting done on the line (not over it). 
SNOWDOME is the clear set weights and measures benefactor (Metro 100 rater carrying only the 57.5) but this could be an awkward map if Brad isn't careful and there is no value at the price. 
SKY DUKE likely lands leaders back for a soft run and a great first up record.
Great race but geez RISSOLES looks the one.

bestBets.overview: HURRICANE HARLEY was a dominant first-up winner before producing a fast-finishing placing at his most recent outing. Pike goes on and I'm expecting him to go very close. SNOW GOD is a talented type who tackles this first up without a trial. He should get a lovely run stalking the speed from his good draw. SIX SHOOTER is a talented sprinter who got the job done first up after enjoying a nice run in transit. He can win again.  SWANSEE is in super fit and in career-best form.

raceTips.comment:
Looks a clear race in three for mine. The no trial is a small mark against SNOW GOD but thought this race map looked very nice for a galloper who I think has room to improve. Fired fresh prior and has met HURRICANE HARLEY previously when just beaten by that galloper but will get a kinder run in transit and a 4.5kg weight swing. 
HARLEY has come back in ripper form though - was very good to get as close as he did last start on a day where it was tough to make ground. Pike in the last. We know how this ends.
SWINGMAN is finally over the 6 furlongs and I think that is where he does his best work. Lochie has done a good job at getting the services of H. Nottle and that luxurious 1.5kg claim. 7 day backup is the query - 14 starts and he's never been tested.
SIX SHOOTER won last start when first up and receiving the kind run in transit. Has to carry the 60kg today but is racing very well.
